threat.description: Sensitive export route may be missing authorization.

entries.title: Semgrep finding: export route has no authorization guard
entries.body: Approved scanner evidence points to the sensitive export endpoint without an authorization guard.

entries.title: Code reference: sensitive export endpoint
entries.body: The handler returns export data from backend/app/api/exports.py and needs a scoped authorization check.

entries.title: DFD context: restricted export flow
entries.body: Authenticated tenant users can reach the Export API, which returns restricted customer data across the application boundary.
